meta_title: Damián Ricobelli · Lead Frontend Engineer and author of Stepperize
meta_description: Lead Frontend Engineer, founder of Wonkka and author of Stepperize. I design and build web products with React, TypeScript and the TanStack ecosystem, since 2017.
common_command_search: Search for a section or an action
guard_body: This site runs on Stepperize, and its guard asks you to visit open source before contact.
hero_now: Lead Frontend Engineer at Urbs Data · Founder of Wonkka
hero_lead: I design and build web products with React, TypeScript and the TanStack ecosystem. Since 2017 I've worked with teams in Argentina, Mexico and the United States, leading architecture, design systems and frontend teams.
hero_code_hint: Each id takes you to its section.
oss_title: Libraries other teams run in production.
oss_intro: Every card is the library running, not a screenshot. Try them right here.
oss_stepperize_desc: Multi-step flows for React with typed ids, guards and results that explain why a navigation was refused.
oss_sz_done: Done. Three steps and no impossible states.
oss_radixcn_desc: shadcn/ui themes generated from Radix Colors scales. Pick a scale and the whole site follows.
oss_phone_desc: A composable, headless phone input. Pick a country and type a number.
oss_combobox_desc: Linear's priority picker, with search and shortcuts from 0 to 4.
oss_cal_desc: Cal.com's scheduler rebuilt with shadcn/ui. You'll use it in the last step.
contact_intro: Working on a product, a team or an idea I could help with? Pick a day and a time and I'll draft the message for you to send.
contact_message: Hi Damián, could we talk on {date} at {time} ({tz})?
palette_placeholder: Search for a section or an action…
footer_credit: Designed and built by Damián Ricobelli.
footer_stack: Made with TanStack Start, shadcn/ui, Motion, Three.js and Paraglide.
career_intro: Nine years of work, newest first
career_wonkka_summary: A platform that serves a business's customers on WhatsApp: it shows real availability, takes bookings and orders, collects payment and keeps everything confirmed in one dashboard.
career_wonkka_h1: Product, design and engineering end to end
career_wonkka_h3: An AI agent that answers and books with the business's real data
career_urbs_summary: I lead frontend development: I set the architecture, hold the quality bar and support the team through every release.
career_iyk_summary: IYK links NFC chips in physical products, like apparel, cards or event passes, to digital experiences for brands such as adidas. I worked on its web platform.
career_roofer_summary: I led the frontend of a platform that turns drone data captured over rooftops into information for the business.
career_roofer_h2: Coordinated the frontend team with backend
career_roofer_h3: Built the design system with the design team
career_guru_summary: I built the hotel websites on the platform and internal tools that made the engineering team faster.
career_guru_h1: Defined the frontend architecture of the products
career_guru_h2: Created internal libraries to improve developer experience
career_flux_summary: Frontend development for the consultancy's clients in Chile and Argentina.
career_flux_h2: An internal Telecom system, with React
career_doc24_summary: I built telemedicine platforms, on the web and on mobile.
career_doc24_h1: Web with React, Redux and Redux Thunk
career_cookep_summary: I co-founded a B2B service, alongside my work as a developer.
career_freelance_summary: Custom websites and web apps for clients, with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP and MySQL. Where it all started.
career_radixcn_summary: Generates complete shadcn/ui themes from Radix Colors scales: colors, typography, shadows and radii.
career_phonefield_summary: A composable, unstyled phone input on Base UI and libphonenumber-js.
career_spenty_summary: Shared expenses without signing up: create a group, share the link and everyone sees what they owe.
career_shadcn_summary: Three shadcn/ui components in six days: Cal.com's scheduler, a phone input and Linear's combobox. Almost a thousand stars today.
career_stepperize_summary: The type-safe way to build multi-step flows in React. My most used project.
